#include<algorithm>
typedef long long ll;
using namespace std;

inline ll read(){
	ll a=0,b=1;

	while(s<'0'||s>'9'){
		if(s=='-') b=-1;
		s=getchar();
	}
	while(s>='0'&&s<='9')
		a=(a<<1)+(a<<3)+(s-'0'),s=getchar();
	return a*b;
}
ll n;
ll cnt1,sum[10];
vector<int> v[10];
void dfs1(int len,int val){
	if(len>6) return;
	v[len].push_back((cnt1-val+mod1)%mod1);
	sum[len]+=(cnt1-val+mod1)%mod1;
	++cnt1;
	for(int i=0;i<=9;i++) dfs1(len+1,val*10+i);

ll cnt2,ans;
inline bool check(ll x){return x*1000000+999999<=n&&x*10000000>n;}
int pw[7]={1,10,100,1000,10000,100000,1000000};

		for(int i=0;i<=6;i++){

			ans=(ans+(sum[i]+v[i].size()*v1-1LL*mod1*(v[i].size()-num)))%mod2;
		}
		cnt2+=cnt1;
	}
	else{
		if(len) ++cnt2;
		ans=(ans+((cnt2-val)%mod1+mod1)%mod1)%mod2;
		for(int i=(!len);i<=9;i++) dfs2(len+1,val*10+i);
	}

int main(){
	n=read();
	dfs1(0,0);

	dfs2(0,0);
